title: Chapter 167 The State Of Qin Is Surging
content:
Chapter 167 The State Of Qin Is Surging

Qin State, in Xianyang Palace.

Sitting on his high throne, Ying Zheng held the secret report quickly sent by the scouts with both hands, fixed his eyes on the content above, pinched the scroll with his fingers, creaking.

"Did you see it? The royal kingdom that popped up in the north has already defeated the kingdom of Yan and plundered 1,000 miles of land from the kingdom of Yan, with millions of people. His strength has grown a lot!" Ying Zheng said fiercely. Throwing the one in his hand under the seat, he said angrily.

Lu Buwei didn't panic when he heard His Majesty the Emperor was so angry. Instead, he walked over, picked up the scroll, glanced at it, sorted it out, and said.

"Your Majesty, why are you so worried? This country is thousands of miles away from our Qin country, and Yanzhao, Han, Wei and the four countries are separated on the way. It is so difficult to get in touch. Why should my Great Qin worry about this country!" Lu Buwei is not unreasonable. I know that this country is a danger to Qin.

His powerful strength has already had a fatal impact on Qin's strategy of unifying the world, but he still said it indifferently, because only in this way can his status in Qin be guaranteed.

The power struggle in the court of Qin State has become more and more intense.

"Bastard, if this country is allowed to continue, when will our unification of Qin be achieved?" Ying Zheng was annoyed when he heard Lu Buwei's words, but he scolded directly, not wanting to hide it.

"However, according to the information I got from the spies, the territory of the Imperial Kingdom is tens of thousands of miles, no less than that of Qin Chu, and the number of soldiers and horses is more than one million, which is better than my Qin Chu. Although I don't know how true or false this information is, but even if it is reduced It is not weaker than my Daqin, how difficult it is to destroy him!" Lu Buwei said lightly, the information that his subordinates had found out, causing many ministers in the court to change their colors.

"Oh, is that so? Why didn't the Gu Wang get this news from Luo Wang? It seems that the Prime Minister is well informed!" Ying Zheng said something strangely, which caused everyone's hearts to turn cold.

Ying Zheng has always known that under Lu Buwei, there has always been a faction headed by him, the Miscellaneous Family. In recent years, with the help of the power of the Qin State, it has expanded extremely rapidly, with tentacles all over the world, from the Xiongnu in the north, Baiyue in the south, Yuezhi in the west, and Qichu in the east. There is no place without the tentacles of miscellaneous families.

"Where, Your Majesty has praised you. Your majesty's scouting report is nothing compared to His Majesty's snare, which has shocked the world and made people in the world know all about it!" Lu Buwei dealt with Ying Zheng casually, without the slightest sincerity.

"The meaning of Xiangguo at that time was to wait and see what happened, do nothing, and just watch the growth of Yuguo!" Ying Zheng sneered.

"It's not what I mean, it's His Majesty's sage's light and thoughtfulness. I and many colleagues in the court also think this method is very good!" Lu Buwei quickly denied, how could he take the blame? It's better to push it to Ying Zheng.

And at the same time, he pulled out his henchmen from the court, and asked them to act together for him and intimidate Yingzheng.

"Exactly, your majesty, the ministers think that what Mr. Xiangguo said is very true. It is very ingenious for the emperor to think carefully and watch the changes quietly!" Following Lu Buwei's hint, there was a clatter on the court hall, and more than half of the people burst out. People, they all agreed with Lu Buwei's words.

"Since this is the case, all my lovers think that what I said is true, so be it! Xiangguo, remember to pay more attention to that Yuguo, keep abreast of his movements, and if there are changes, you must report to this king!" Gritting teeth, the real Gritting his teeth, Ying Zheng wished he could immediately call up the guards and kill these people to vent his hatred.

However, he knows that now is not the time to kill these people, and he does not have the ability to kill these people, because he himself does not know how many guards in this palace are loyal to him?

"Retire!" With the sharp duck voice of the servant, many ministers in the court also dispersed after Ying Zheng left.

However, on the way to leave, they gathered together in twos and threes, especially Lu Buwei. Dozens of ministers followed him closely like a dog, and there were endless voices of flattery.

Standing on the palace, Ying Zheng looked at the group of ministers who were at odds with him, his eyes were full of murderous intent, but his heart was extremely calm, but he did make up his mind to speed up his actions.

At this moment, the court is still in danger and cannot move.

The family of Yin and Yang, under Luo Shengtang.

At this moment, Donghuang Taiyi, who was wearing a mysterious golden black robe, was looking up at the incomparably mysterious stars in the sky, little by little, revolving around a certain special rhythm.

"Your Excellency Donghuang, have you discovered anything by looking at the stars?" Luna, who was dressed in a blue dress, tall and straight, and full of charm, asked.

"The world has changed, the destiny that originally belonged to Qin has been disturbed, and it has gone in a direction that even I can't see!" Donghuang sighed, and couldn't help but lament that fate is so impermanent and elusive.

"Oh, Master Donghuang's ability can't see this fate? Could it be because of the new royal kingdom that appeared in the north?" As the great witch of the Yinyang family, Luna rarely saw Donghuang behave like this, and even said he had never seen it at all. Pass.

"Yeah, ever since this imperial kingdom appeared in front of the eyes of the people in the world, the fate of the whole world has undergone tremendous changes with his appearance!" Donghuang said helplessly, because of the appearance of this imperial kingdom, the Yin-Yang family The plan that has been planned for a long time has to be changed accordingly.

"Then how should we, the Yin-Yang Family, deal with it?" Moon God asked softly when he heard Donghuang's words.

"Wait and see what happens, and send some people to Yuguo to investigate!" Donghuang ordered.

"However, according to the intelligence reports from Yun Zhongjun and others who fled back, the commander of the Yu Kingdom's army this time, the mysterious Prince Jing, seems to be him. Going to Yuguo, will there be any accidents?" Thinking of the previous descriptions of Yunzhong Jun and others, all of which match the figure of Yuguo, Prince Jing, Luna is a little worried.

"No, Yun Zhongjun also said before that Yuguo is because my Yinyang family has been very close to Qin State these years. They are afraid that my Yinyang family will help Qin State, so they eradicated it in advance and weakened it as much as possible. As long as my Yinyang family Put aside as much relationship with Qin as possible, and Yu Guo will not specifically target my Yin-Yang family!" Thinking of this, Donghuang didn't care much.

"Leave anything to do with Qin. If we do this, wouldn't the previous efforts of my Yin-Yang family be in vain? And I will also offend Qin, the most powerful country among the seven kingdoms in the world, which has the most potential to unify the world!" Moon God heard Donghuang Surprised by the decision.

"It doesn't matter. With the emergence of this royal kingdom, Qin's destiny to unify the world has become very elusive, and even impossible to achieve!" Donghuang said this lightly, enough to make people in the world change color. if.
